title: Diagnostic Packet
user: Developers escalating a hard-to-reproduce local tool, editor, or environment failure who need to send a safe, complete reproduction packet without manually assembling screenshots, logs, versions, and configuration.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that runs an opt-in project diagnostic manifest, captures tool versions/config hashes/redacted logs/reproduction commands, and exports a self-contained zip plus readable HTML.
success_measure: For pilot bug reports, maintainers request one fewer follow-up clarification on average and reproduce 70% of reported failures from the packet.
constraints: Every collector is allowlisted and previewable; redact tokens, home paths, and PII; make archive contents inspectable before export; no background collection.
